items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I guess Nori, the trombone that's left here when he was pretty young.

ctx.x: Played Cranet? No, uh, trombone. He was with Joe Oliver later. He left here pretty early though. I think he'd never played here much after he was. But I mean, is he akin to Dutre the Tranny, please? Yeah, Sam Dutre. Yeah, Sam. He was his brother. Oh yeah, well I remember Sam Dutre, but I don't remember him.
I guess Nori, the trombone that's left here when he was pretty young. Is his name again? Uh, playing trombone too. He was a good trombone player too.
Uh, this fella, uh, this fella's name again.
